dead-url.note: Not a judge calibration case — a T1 (deterministic) calibration case. A bundle whose prototype_url points at a killed tunnel must FAIL url_alive() and never reach the judge at all (evals/runner.py's T1-gates-T2 contract, §1.6 M2). This session hit this exact failure mode three separate times for real (see git log: the ngrok tunnel-matching and cache-staleness fixes) before it was fixed — this case exists so a regression in that gating logic is caught here, not rediscovered live again.
